plan.change: Phase C post-merge adversarial canary: trusted success path and unusual Git filenames
expectedChanges: Create only disposable canary files under .change-canary with unusual but valid UTF-8 Git path identities.
Exercise the merged base-owned Change PR Gate and Change Verification Evidence workflows on the exact canary head.
Inspect trusted evidence provenance, rerun provenance, human-readable escaping, and required-check enforcement without merging the canary.
hqDecisions: This PR is disposable evidence-only canary work and must be closed unmerged after inspection.
Use valid UTF-8 unusual filenames including newline, backslash, quote, and pathspec-like characters; do not introduce production content.
The canary must not modify workflows or trusted tools.
plan.manualCheckExemptionReason: Disposable canary; verification is performed by trusted workflows and artifact inspection rather than product behavior.
plan.rollback: Close the canary PR unmerged; no staging/main or production content change is intended.
outOfScope: Phase D beyond already-remediated path identity cases
Phase E semantic scope and concurrency controls
unverified: This canary does not itself declare final VERIFIED; it validates the trusted mechanical evidence path.
plan.problem: After merging the Phase C3-1 remediations, the trust boundary needs live post-merge evidence that the base-owned workflows, path identity handling, report escaping, ruleset and provenance fields behave as designed.
plan.currentContract: staging/main now contains the hardened Change PR Gate, trusted Change Verification Evidence, path identity fixes, human report escaping, active main ruleset, and triggeringActor provenance.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: PR-level unit tests and pre-merge runs cannot prove the newly merged base-owned workflow source is actually executing or that rerun evidence and protected-main enforcement behave correctly after merge.
plan.design: Open a disposable lock-first PR from current staging/main with unusual valid UTF-8 filenames only under .change-canary. Require trusted workflows to pass, inspect the evidence artifact, rerun the trusted evidence job and inspect runAttempt/actor provenance, then close the PR unmerged.
alternativesRejected: Merge the canary into staging/main; unnecessary residue would remain in the canonical branch.
Rely only on source tests; they do not exercise post-merge pull_request_target execution.
Use production as the canary target; production changes are prohibited.
plan.compatibility: The canary adds no production behavior and is intended to be closed unmerged.
boundaryCases: A newline-containing filename remains one Git identity and its human report representation is escaped.
A literal backslash filename is not normalized to a slash path.
A quote and pathspec-like filename remain literal identities.
The evidence targetSha equals the exact PR head and workflowSha equals the post-merge base-owned workflow commit.
A rerun increments runAttempt and records triggeringActor.
testPlan: Open the disposable PR and confirm Change Operations Tests, Change PR Gate and Change Verification Evidence run on the exact head.
Inspect trusted-mechanical-evidence JSON for exact repository/baseSha/targetSha/planLock/producer/check fields and UNVERIFIED state.
Inspect Scope human logs for escaped unusual path rendering.
Rerun the trusted verification job and inspect runAttempt plus actor and triggeringActor.
Confirm required checks/ruleset state and close the canary PR unmerged.
plan.promotionRisk: Disposable staging canary only. Risk is limited to repository workflow noise and branch residue; no merge or production promotion is intended.
